head: 85df5e8ac8be204c79bceec8032f88f9c18cd00c
title: Inflight commit dry run is handed the raw precise_amount before the plain amount is resolved

bugs.anchor: Projected before the precision lookup below
bugs.note: The dry-run branch returns before the request amount is converted with the transaction precision, so a caller that sends only amount gets nil, which means commit the full remaining hold. The preview then reports success for a commit larger than the hold that the real path rejects.
